name: claude-chat-style
description: A chat look for the terminal: your prompts as right-aligned blue bubbles, Claude's replies in orange boxes with an orange dot, questions tagged, tool rows left native.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Draw prompts and replies in this style. Off leaves Claude Code's own drawing.

replyColor.title: Reply colour
replyColor.description: Colour of Claude's reply dot, box and question tag: a hex colour or a theme key.

promptColor.title: Prompt colour
promptColor.description: Border colour of your prompts' bubbles: a hex colour or a theme key.

replyWidthPercent.title: Reply width
replyWidthPercent.description: Widest Claude's prose boxes get, in percent of the terminal width (20 to 100); the same as promptWidthPercent mirrors your bubbles.

codeWidthPercent.title: Code and table width
codeWidthPercent.description: Widest replies with code blocks or tables get, in percent of the terminal width (20 to 100).

promptWidthPercent.title: Prompt width
promptWidthPercent.description: Widest your prompt bubbles get, in percent of the terminal width (20 to 100).

replyIndent.title: Reply indent
replyIndent.description: Columns between the terminal's left edge and Claude's boxes (0 to 20). 1 balances the desktop app's terminal pane, which pads its right side about one column more than its left; 0 suits a terminal with even padding.
